title: Honeywell International Recalls SWIFT® Wireless Gateway Sold with Fire Alarm Systems Due To Failure to Communicate in Fire
summary: The smoke detectors connected to the gateway can fail to activate properly when significant environmental contaminants are present, posing a risk that consumers will not be alerted to a fire. Units: About 900.

title: Little Passports Recalls Science Kits Due to Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The battery packs included in the science kits can overheat, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 7,000 (in addition, 700 were sold in Canada).

title: Carrier and Bryant Recall Heat Pumps Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The capacitors in the fuse boards in the heat pumps can stop working causing the unit to overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 23,300 (In addition about 2,000 sold in Canada).

title: Nature’s Truth Recalls Iron Supplement Bottles Due to Failure to Meet Child-Resistant Closure Requirement
summary: The packaging is not child-resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The tablets inside the bottle contain iron, which can cause serious injury or death to young children if multiple tablets are ingested at once. Units: About 520.

title: Night Lights Recalled by AM Conservation Group Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The night lights can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 37,000.

title: Profile Design Recalls Bicycle Handlebar Stems Due to Loss of Control and Crash Hazard
summary: The bicycle handlebar stems can corrode and break, causing the rider to lose control and crash. Units: About 9,700 in the U.S. (135 were sold in Canada).

title: Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Recalled by American Honda Due to Risk of Injury (Recall Alert)
summary: The front passenger seat belt buckle can fail due to a manufacturing defect, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 2,200.

title: Snowmobiles Recalled by Polaris Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: A weld on the steering post can separate, resulting in loss of steering control, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 6,000.

title: Segway Reannounces Recall of Off-Board Chargers for Segway Personal Transporters Due to Shock Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: A wire inside the charger can detach and touch the side of the charger, posing a shock hazard. Units: About 24 (in addition, 17 were previously recalled in September 2015).

title: Springs Window Fashions Recalls Lithium Batteries Sold with Motorized Window Coverings Due to Fire and Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The lithium batteries that power the motorized window coverings can overheat, leak or discharge, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 59,100 in the U.S. (in addition, about 2,100 were sold in Canada).

title: Women's Scarves Recalled by DGFA Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The women's scarves fail to meet federal flammability standard for clothing textiles, posing a risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 200.

title: Combi USA Recalls Stroller and Car Seat Combos Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The car seat can disengage from the stroller's frame, posing a fall hazard to infants. Units: About 1,000.

title: Goodman Recalls Furnaces Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: The blower motor is not grounded, posing an electrical shock hazard to individuals servicing the units Units: About 4,100.

title: HoMedics Recalls Massagers Due to Electric Shock and Burn Hazards
summary: The cord can break near the base of the massager and expose the wires, posing an electric shock and burn hazards. Units: About 400,000.

title: Cordless Electric Lawn Mowers Recalled Due to Fire Hazard; Made by Hongkong Sun Rise Trading
summary: The circuit board in the lawn mower can short circuit and catch fire, posing a fire hazard to users. Units: About 28,000.

title: Extech Recalls Digital Clamp Meters Due to Electrocution Hazard
summary: The meters can fail to give an accurate voltage reading, resulting in the operator falsely believing the electrical power is low or off, posing an electrocution hazard. Units: 1,700 (in addition, about 20 were sold in Canada).

title: Office Chairs Recalled by Leggett & Platt Office Components Due to Fall Hazard
summary: Seat slider bolts and push nuts can disconnect and fall from the chair, which could cause the seat to detach from the chair, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 47,900 in the U.S. (in addition, about 1,000 in Canada).

title: Williams-Sonoma Recalls Rejuvenation Wall Sconces Due to Shock Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The joint of the articulating arm can pinch or cut the electrical wire causing it to fray, posing a shock hazard. Units: About 1,055.

title: Dynacraft Recalls Ride-On Toys Due to Fall and Crash Hazards
summary: The acceleration pedal on the ride-on toys can stick, posing fall and crash hazards. Units: About 20,000.

title: Hobby Lobby Recalls Easter and July 4th Light-Up Spinner Toys Due to Choking and Ingestion Hazards
summary: The battery cover can detach and expose the small coin cell batteries, posing choking and ingestion hazards to young children. Units: About 43,400.

title: Pier 1 Imports Recalls Temani Wicker Furniture Due to Violation of Federal Lead Paint Standard
summary: The paint used on the wicker furniture can contain excessive levels of lead, which is a violation of the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 2,500 (in addition, about 75 units sold in Canada).

title: Sportex Recalls Rock Salt Lamps Due to Shock and Fire Hazards
summary: The dimmer switch and/or outlet plug can overheat and ignite, posing shock and fire hazards. Units: About 3,900 (80,000 lamps were previously recalled in January 2017).

title: Following Plumber's Death, Electric Ranges Recalled by Arçelik A.S. Due to Shock and Electrocution Hazards
summary: The electric ranges can become energized, posing electric shock and electrocution hazards to a consumer who touches the range Units: About 6,300.

title: Pulse Performance Products Recalls Krusher Scooters Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The down tube can break, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 18,700.

title: Michaels Recalls Ceramic Travel Mugs Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The mug's lid does not fit securely and can cause liquids to leak from the bottom of the lid when tilted, posing a burn hazard. Also, the mug does not have a silicone hand wrap so the consumer could burn their hand on the side walls of the mug. Units: About 27,000.

title: Pier 1 Imports Recalls Chalk Note Mugs Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The mugs can crack when filled with hot liquid, posing a burn hazard to users. Units: About 15,300 (in addition, about 900 were sold in Canada).

title: Cabrinha Recalls Kiteboard Control Systems Due to Injury and Fall Hazards
summary: The point of connection between the lower front line with the landing line can break, causing a loss of kite control, posing injury and fall hazards. Units: About 2,900.

title: Douglas Recalls Plush Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The plastic eyes on the plush toys can detach, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 25,000.

title: Bradshaw International Recalls Coffee Presses Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The glass beakers can break during normal use, posing a laceration hazard to users. Units: About 85,000 (in addition, 300 were sold in Canada).

title: VanMoof Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall and Impact Hazards
summary: The front fender bolts do not break when an object gets stuck between the front tire and the front fender/mud guard, posing fall and impact hazards. Units: 375.
